Move mouse to look 
Click to jump

trigger_01.text: Banished from your people's planet onto an unknown and strange world, you wake up. The air is thick and full of smog

trigger_02.text: Wandering deeper into the mantle, you realize; these are the artifacts of a lost civilization.

trigger_03.text: Your family and friends are just a distant memory now. There isn't a way back.

trigger_04.text: The world you once knew starts to fade. People forgot your name. Forgot the names of places you knew and cherished. Forget your species ever existed in the first place.
